en: Not my cup of tea, but seems comfortable enough.
ko: 내 취향은 아니지만, 꽤 편해 보이네.

en: I feel like some sort of evil king in this chair. Very powerful looking.
ko: 이 의자에 앉으니 무슨 사악한 왕이 된 기분이야. 아주 강력해 보여.

en: Awesome to flop onto, but hard to sit in.
Comfy enough, but I feel like it'd be really easy to stub your toe on it.
ko: 꽤 편하지만 발가락 찧기 정말 쉬울 것 같아.

en: Seems to be draining all the water away. If I put my hand on it it makes a farting sound.
ko: 물을 다 빨아들이는 것 같아. 손을 대면 방귀 소리가 나.

en: Wow, this water is cold! Tastes good, though.
ko: 와, 이 물 차갑다! 맛은 좋네.

en: A 3d printer for making snowmen? Now I feel like a kid again!
ko: 눈사람을 만드는 3D 프린터라고? 다시 어린애가 된 기분이야!

en: This'll generate a lot of power, but it'll eat up fuel.
ko: 전력을 많이 만들지만 연료를 엄청 먹겠어.

en: Cool hatch. Too bad it isn't opening right now.
ko: 멋진 해치야. 지금 안 열리는 게 아쉽네.

en: If I can reboot this station S.A.I.L. should come back online!
ko: 이 스테이션을 재부팅하면 S.A.I.L이 다시 온라인이 될 거야!

en: Classy drop down screen for a S.A.I.L station. The screen kinda reminds me of a Virtual Boy.
ko: S.A.I.L 스테이션용 고급 드롭다운 화면이야. 버추얼 보이가 생각나네.

en: Teleporting is a huge rush. Too bad this one isn't powered up.
ko: 텔레포트는 짜릿해. 이건 전원이 안 들어온 게 아쉽네.

en: A ship's locker. It's not working.
Whatever this is, i'm not touching it. It seems like it's a SAIL console though.
ko: 뭔지는 모르겠지만 안 건드려. SAIL 콘솔 같긴 하지만.

en: The Skath seem to restrict the access to their codex entries.
ko: 스카스는 자기들 코덱스 기록의 접근을 제한하는 것 같아.

en: Looks like a retro oven to me, but it probably works well enough.
ko: 레트로 오븐 같아 보여. 아마 잘 작동할 거야.

en: Now that's a high quality carpenter's workbench!
This Skath flag can be saved as a location for my teleporter. Then I can return to it at any time.
ko: 이 스카스 깃발은 텔레포터 위치로 저장할 수 있어. 언제든 돌아올 수 있지.

en: The Hylotl use similar airlocks, I think.
ko: 하이로틀이 비슷한 에어락을 쓰는 것 같아.

en: Looks like someone put a towel over a metal table and called it a bed.
ko: 누가 금속 탁자에 수건을 덮고 침대라 부른 것 같아.

en: This bench is long and comfy enough to work as a bed! Maybe I could take a little nap...
ko: 이 벤치는 길고 편해서 침대로 쓸 수 있겠어! 낮잠이나 잘까...

en: Looks like a lava lamp. Without the lava, though.
Looks like a neat chair for anyone who has a tail. Nothing for me, personally.
ko: 꼬리 있는 사람한테 딱 좋은 의자 같네. 나한텐 아니지만.

en: That's an interesting design for a console. I wonder what it does?
ko: 콘솔치고 재미있는 디자인이야. 뭘 하는 걸까?

en: I should make a wish while I'm here.
I heard on Earth people tried to harness fusion reactors, too. It didn't end well.
ko: 지구에서도 사람들이 핵융합로를 쓰려 했다고 들어. 좋게 끝나진 않았지.

en: This thing looks really heavy. If I tried to lift it, I might break my back.
ko: 이거 정말 무거워 보여. 들면 허리가 나가겠어.

en: I hear no one's ever visited the Skath homeworld. No wonder, with all their orbital weapons.
ko: 스카스 모행성에 간 사람이 없다던데. 저 궤도 무기들을 보면 당연하지.

en: I've heard of these, these were made to detect liquid for fancy wiring set-ups.
ko: 이런 건 들어봤어, 근사한 배선용으로 액체를 감지하는 거래.

en: The sort of table you can't flip over. Good for a game of cards.
ko: 뒤집을 수 없는 탁자야. 카드게임 하기 좋겠어.

en: I could have a bite. Just need to find out how to open the microwave...
ko: 한 입 먹어도 되겠어. 전자레인지 여는 법만 찾으면...

en: This thing looks really heavy. If I try to lift it, I might break my back.
ko: 이거 정말 무거워 보여. 들면 허리가 나갈지도.

en: It appears to be a monitor of some sort, but what is it monitoring? And who monitors the monitor?
ko: 일종의 모니터 같아, 근데 뭘 감시하는 거지? 그리고 누가 감시자를 감시하지?

en: It's like a torch, but more sci-fi.
A bright, blue light.
Assault Shotgun, eh? That's a weird mix.
What a pointy looking spear! Perfect for spear fishing!.
ko: 뾰족해 보이는 창이다! 창 낚시에 딱이겠어!

en: These spears don't look very shar- Ouch! Okay, they are!
ko: 이 창들은 별로 날카롭지 않아 보여- 아야! 알겠어, 날카롭네!

en: This sword's gigantic! I wonder if I can wield it? Probably not.
ko: 이 검이 엄청나게 커! 휘두를 수 있을까? 아마 못할 거야.

en: Well thats a neat looking table.
One shot from this could tear right through my ship. Good thing it's on the other side of the planet.
ko: 이거 한 방이면 내 함선을 뚫겠어. 행성 반대편에 있어서 다행이야.

en: Skath TV shows? I should check them out.
I hope this is a water dispenser. I am really thirsty.
Amazing, a high-tech cup of water! Isn't technology great?.
ko: 대단해, 첨단 기술 물컵이야! 기술이란 대단하지 않아?

en: I ran at a door like this once.
ko: 저런 문을 향해 달려본 적이 있어.

en: A control blob. It's just gotta be played with.
Probably a trampoline.
Ew.  How does this even work?
How's this even work?  It's made of slime.
This looks as comftable as a bean bag.
Sticky door.
A personal teleporter! Now this is travelling in style, but it's not really up to my taste.
ko: 개인용 텔레포터야! 근사한 여행 방식이지만 내 취향은 아니야.

en: Isn't this musical instrument too anachronistic to be in a futuristic space setting?
ko: 이 악기가 미래 우주 배경에 너무 시대착오적 아닌가?

en: Hey, where have I seen that guy before?
Looks like a cat took this box over.
ko: 고양이가 이 상자를 차지한 것 같아.

en: This scratching post can be saved as a location for my teleporter. Then I can return to it at any time.
ko: 이 스크래치 기둥은 텔레포터 위치로 저장할 수 있어. 언제든 돌아올 수 있지.

en: Looks like a cat got their claws in this one...
ko: 고양이가 이걸 발톱으로 갉아놓은 것 같아...

en: Let's not.
Peace, yo.
This 'Jalmine' must be a pretty famous figure to the cats.
Why would cats have a baywatch?
Kilroy was here.
This ham's glaze... It looks so... glorious!
ko: 이 햄의 글레이즈... 정말... 영광스러워 보여!

en: It's not really clear how much is romance and how much is comedy.
They actually did it. They ruined breakfast.
Hey, it's the original series!
This 'Letrune' must be a pretty important figure to the cats.
Oh, hey. She's topless.
Slabs of delicious cooked alien meat.
More bacon! All the bacon!
Are you seducing me, ma'am?
Do I get to wear the cool armor if I join?
ko: 가입하면 멋진 갑옷 입을 수 있어?

en: I can't read this. Silly flourishes.
I could wear these. I could. I don't think I should.
ko: 이걸 입을 수 있겠어. 입을 수는 있어. 입으면 안 될 것 같지만.

en: This 'Laenathin' must be a pretty famous figure to the cats.
I am SO CONFLICTED right now.
I am feeling so weird right now.
Tentacles. Chewy and a bit disturbing.
I guess?
Not sure what this lady's deal was.
This feels really nostalgic somehow.
This 'Chelsie' must be a pretty famous figure to the cats.
Yes folks, the cats have discovered shopping music.
ko: 그래 여러분, 고양이들이 쇼핑 음악을 발견했어.

en: No mom, I won't do the dishes! You can't tell me what to do!
ko: 엄마, 설거지 안 할래! 뭐라고 해도 소용없어!

en: Here, kitty kitty...
What kind of gas glows orange when electrified?
ko: 전기를 통하면 주황색으로 빛나는 가스가 뭐지?

en: I like this one.
Beware cats without clothes.
Bad choice in partners.
Did that tentacle on the top shelf just wriggle?
ko: 맨 위 선반의 저 촉수 방금 꼬물댔어?

en: I want one of those.
This 'Laenathin' must be a pretty important figure to the cats.
Haa hah, I don't know who this is.
Carrot cake's better than it sounds.
That costume looks oddly Arabic.
I can't tell if this is a guy or a girl! Help!
Cerise?
Woah, that's deep.
These weapons look like children's toys. Children with bad parents.
ko: 이 무기들은 어린이 장난감 같아. 나쁜 부모 둔 어린이용.

en: This 'Letrune' must be a pretty famous figure to the cats.
I don't think these tents are built for camping.
ko: 이 천막들은 캠핑용이 아닌 것 같아.

en: If I remember correctly, this spinny gadget are used to seperate liquids.
ko: 기억이 맞다면, 이 회전 장치는 액체를 분리하는 거야.

en: It costs four hundred thousand pixels to fire this thing for twelve seconds.
That looks like something that would kill me if I pick it.
ko: 저걸 뽑으면 날 죽일 것 같아.

en: Now that's a fire hazard if I've ever seen one.
Makes me wanna kick back with a pina colada.
ko: 피냐 콜라다 들고 쉬고 싶게 만드네.

en: I wonder how old this painting is.
What could be in here? Bad poetry?
I think I can see a few prayers for us. How considerate!
ko: 우리를 위한 기도문 몇 개가 보이는 것 같아. 배려 깊네!

en: I really wonder what this pillar is saying.
ko: 이 기둥이 뭐라고 하는지 정말 궁금해.

en: That's certainly a unique choice of a lamp
I can't help but expect this thing is gonna explode.
ko: 이게 터질 것 같아서 계속 신경 쓰여.

en: I'm guessing this is a warning to people like me.
ko: 이건 나 같은 사람들을 향한 경고겠지.

en: I remember hearing about people finding the Divern in the deep seas.
ko: 깊은 바다에서 다이번을 찾았다는 얘기를 들었어.

en: Smells like hot garbage.
I think this plant can be used as a switch of some sort.
ko: 이 식물은 일종의 스위치로 쓸 수 있는 것 같아.

en: I always imagined the Hylotl using tridents. Not these.
ko: 난 항상 하이로틀이 삼지창을 쓴다고 생각했어. 이건 아니지.

en: What does what with here?
Wonder how many trails this thing has travelled...
I'm guessing smoking isn't allowed around here.
Hate to be at the business end of this thing. Or in it, for that matter.
ko: 이거의 사업부 쪽엔 있기 싫어. 안에 있는 것도 마찬가지고.

en: I can't tell if those are angry Hylotl eyes, or a trident head.
ko: 저게 화난 하이로틀 눈인지 삼지창 머리인지 모르겠어.

en: Whoever wrote this thing must've thought that big words make them sound smart.
ko: 이걸 쓴 사람은 큰 단어를 쓰면 똑똑해 보인다 생각했나 봐.

en: Wow, that looks so cool.
Hmm. What happens if mix...
